thread:
maria: heads-up: seeing 2-3ms tail on host parse when streams have many small chunks. Noting CPU jump on hostproxy process. Anyone else?

aj: saw similar after http2 change. Repro with loadtest? https://perf.redwood.local/dashboard/ingress-small-chunks

ken: can you paste flame? also ping @simone

maria: attaching small flame snippet:
```
HostParse::tokenize 1.9ms
HostParse::frame_read 0.8ms
HTTP2::hpack_decode 2.2ms
grpc-writev 0.3ms
```
seems hpack decode spikes with many tiny frames

perf-bot: perf snapshot 6112233400
```
baseline: host-parse=1.1ms 95th=2.0ms
current: host-parse=3.5ms 95th=6.8ms
kv-cache-hits=82% -> 70%
batch-size avg=1.9 -> 1.2
```

simone: kernel selection might be switching to generic GEMM on these inputs, batching collapsed. Could we be dropping continuous batching because parse emits small partial requests? @aj any change in preparse coalescer?

aj: we landed an http2 frame-split optimizer two days ago. It splits large frames but also left a path that returns early for small frames. I'll revert locally to verify.

ken: also check that tokenizer pool isn't re-allocating buffers per frame. last time that caused extra memcpy and host CPU spike

maria: quick experiment: toggled hpack off -> host-parse 1.2ms. So hpack seems culprit for tiny-chunk traffic.

simone: potential fixes:
- avoid per-frame hpack decode for consecutive continuation frames (cache header table across stream)
- buffer up to X bytes before decode (trade latency for CPU)
- re-enable coalesce path that merges small writes into a single batch

aj: i'll try reapplying coalesce and add a unit that folds small frames for a few ms window. test plan: run 50k rps with 50-200 token streams and measure 95th/avg

maria: can we also emit a tag so the routing layer can prefer kernel A vs B based on avg seq len? Might avoid GEMM fallback and keep faster tiled kernels.

ken: noted. I'll add a perf flag to runtime that forces kernel0 for seq<256 and run CI perf. If that helps we can wire heuristics.

maria: thanks. let's reconvene after aj's revert and ken's kernel flag. If perf-bot shows kv hit drop still, we'll look at preparse kv population.

aj: working on revert now, will post logs in ~30m :thumbsup:
